newsitem.title: USA: First Industrial files $200 mln common shelf.
newsitem.headline: First Industrial files $200 mln common shelf.

text.p: First Industrial Realty Trust Inc filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to $200 million in common stock.
When combined with a previous registration, the company will have up to $236.15 million worth of common shares available for sale, according to the filing.
The company said net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including the acquisition or additional properties, repayment of debt or improvement of certain portfolio properties.
No underwriters were listed in the filing.
